verdict.defect: CONFIRMED — the pre-repair fold under-normalized the folded FP term by exactly fp_ell_eff (13.59–13.65x per mock), derived independently from a sightline-counting argument, not by reproducing the claim's arithmetic
verdict.repair: CORRECT (exact) — fp_ell_eff is the exactly-required exposure factor given the calibration likelihood; validated ABSOLUTELY on the twin mock: mu_FP / (chance-corrected physical forest-FP census) = 1.0020. Known residual bias: the fold omits the loa-0 product's own (1-eta_band) occlusion factor (-0.58% on the FP term, sub-DLA band), immaterial vs the 10.6% Poisson width of the 89-count calibration
verdict.ceiling_claim: SAME-ESTIMAND: NO. (1) The comparator called 'unmatched detections' is NOT the committed primary unmatched estimand (vs which mu_FP is 23-39% BELOW, not above); it is the hostless-at-truth-floor-17.2 class. (2) The claimed bound direction ('unmatched over-counts forest FP, so the excess is a lower bound') is INVERTED for that comparator: chance z-coincidence with the dense >=17.2 truth (measured 8.5-9.0% by z-scramble) makes it an UNDER-count of the forest-FP supply. After correction the excess is 1.002 (2LPT-0: GONE), 1.447 (London-0), 1.307 (Saclay-0): a cross-mock TRANSPORT failure, not a normalization failure

task1_dimensional_derivation.counting_argument: r_hat[c,s] = n0[c,s]/ns0 (FP per searched loa-0 sightline); expected mock FP census = r_hat * nsm * (1-eta). Model: n0 ~ Poisson(ell*lam), ell = ns0^2/nsm => lam_hat = n0*nsm/ns0^2; fold w*ell*lam_hat = (nsm/ns0)*n0 = r_hat*nsm. Reproduces the counting answer EXACTLY ONCE, except (1-eta) which appears nowhere in the Model A chain although the commit message equates the fold to an expression containing it
task1_dimensional_derivation.why_ell_is_ns0sq_over_nsm: likelihood-inert reparameterization (any positive constant works if fold and calibration share it; verified posterior-identical in r02). The convention makes the Gamma-posterior variance of the folded total equal the frequentist variance of the production-extrapolated count Var[w*n0] = w^2*n0 — inherited 'production-extrapolation variance' bookkeeping from the Q2 Loa0FP product
task1_dimensional_derivation.identity_w_times_ell_eq_ns0: an algebraic TAUTOLOGY of the extractor's two definitions ((nsm/ns0)*(ns0^2/nsm) = ns0 for ANY nsm); its numerical check verifies float round-trip and pack integrity, not physics. Verified == 2255.0 EXACTLY on: 2lpt0_v11, london0_v11, saclay0_v11, 2lpt0_nonv11, london0_nonv11 (raw and coarsen_basis(0.1, pad 19.0)), and 3 freshly extracted adopted-config packs. saclay0 non-v11 npz is ABSENT from the preserved dir (only its .provenance.json exists) — 5 of the 6 requested packs exist
task1_dimensional_derivation.exp_t: applied once, fold-side only; calibration has no exp(t) because t is the loa-0->mock transfer (identity on loa-0 by definition). Consistent
task1_dimensional_derivation.eta: eta enters ZERO times in Model A (fp_counts are raw counts; fp_E_alloc is a dX share; fp_w, fp_ell are pure ratios). The loa-0 product and the Q2 FF route (cddf_catalog_hbi.Loa0FP.mu_fp_*) both carry (1-eta_band); Model A's fold does not. Product values: eta_subdla = 0.005757, eta_lls = 0.011187, eta_dla = 0 (forced)

task3_prior_sensitivity.conclusion: The two options (lam an intensity + ell in the fold vs lam' = ell*lam a count) are posterior-identical to 9.26e-7 relative — exactly the predicted eps*(1/ell - 1) tilt from the Gamma(1/2, eps=1e-6) exponential cutoff; the x^{-1/2} power-law part transforms into itself times a constant, the ZeroSumNormal->softmax shape prior never sees the total (v-gradient of the log-likelihood identical under (total, ell) vs (ell*total, 1) to 2.8e-8), and NUTS geometry differs only by a constant shift log(ell) in the sampled log-total coordinate. The choice is genuinely immaterial
